ucs.title: [LLM] 8Base/Phobos ransomware deployment via PsExec-style service install on ADMIN$ followed by ransomware file markers
ucs.description: Hunts the characteristic 8Base affiliate chain: PsExec/SmbExec-style remote service installation (service binary written to ADMIN$ or %WINDIR% with PSEXESVC-like names) followed within ~30 minutes by Phobos-family encryption markers (.8base / .phobos / .eight / .eking extensions, info.hta/info.txt ransom notes). 8Base is a Phobos affiliate whose post-access tradecraft fuses T1021.002 + T1569.002 + T1486 in a tight window — alone, service install is noise; paired with the encryption tail, it's near-zero-FP.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as service_time max(_time) as last_service_time from datamodel=Endpoint.Services where (Services.service_name IN ("PSEXESVC*","PAExec*","remcom*","csrss*") OR Services.service_path_name="*\\ADMIN$\\*" OR Services.service_path_name="*\\Windows\\*.exe") AND Services.service_path_name!="*\\System32\\svchost.exe*" by Services.dest Services.user Services.service_name Services.service_path_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Services)` | join type=inner dest [| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as ransom_time from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="*.8base" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.phobos" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.eight" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.eking" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.devos" OR Filesystem.file_name="info.hta" OR Filesystem.file_name="info.txt") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`] | eval delay_sec=ransom_time-service_time | where delay_sec>=0 AND delay_sec<=1800 | table service_time, ransom_time, delay_sec, dest, user, service_name, service_path_name, file_name, file_path | sort - service_time
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let Services = DeviceEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType == "ServiceInstalled"
    | where (FileName has_any ("PSEXESVC","PAExec","remcom","csrss")
           or FolderPath has @"\ADMIN$\"
           or (FolderPath matches regex @"(?i)^[A-Z]:\\Windows\\[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,12}\.exe$"))
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "services.exe"
    | project ServiceTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, ServiceFile = FileName,
              ServicePath = FolderPath, ServiceAccount = AccountName, ServiceCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let Ransom = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("FileRenamed","FileCreated")
    | where FileName endswith ".8base"
         or FileName endswith ".phobos"
         or FileName endswith ".eight"
         or FileName endswith ".eking"
         or FileName endswith ".devos"
         or FileName =~ "info.hta"
         or FileName =~ "info.txt"
    | project RansomTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RansomFile = FileName,
              RansomPath = FolderPath, RansomProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              RansomCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
Services
| join kind=inner Ransom on DeviceId
| where RansomTime between (ServiceTime .. ServiceTime + 30m)
| project ServiceTime, RansomTime,
          DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', RansomTime, ServiceTime),
          DeviceName, ServiceFile, ServicePath, ServiceAccount,
          RansomFile, RansomPath, RansomProcess, RansomCmd
| summarize arg_min(ServiceTime, *) by DeviceName
| order by ServiceTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let Services = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 7045 or EventID == 4697
    | extend SvcName = tostring(extract(@"(?i)Service Name:\s*(\S+)", 1, EventData))
    | extend SvcFile = coalesce(ServiceFileName, tostring(extract(@"(?i)Service File Name:\s*([^\r\n]+)", 1, EventData)))
    | where SvcName matches regex @"(?i)^(PSEXESVC|PAExec|remcom|csrss)"
         or SvcFile has_any (@"\ADMIN$\", @"\C$\")
         or SvcFile matches regex @"(?i)[A-Z]:\\Windows\\[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,12}\.exe$"
    | project ServiceTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SvcName, SvcFile, ServiceUser = SubjectUserName;
let Ransom = DeviceFileEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("FileRenamed","FileCreated")
    | where FileName endswith ".8base"
         or FileName endswith ".phobos"
         or FileName endswith ".eight"
         or FileName endswith ".eking"
         or FileName endswith ".devos"
         or FileName =~ "info.hta"
         or FileName =~ "info.txt"
    | project RansomTime = TimeGenerated, Computer = DeviceName, RansomFile = FileName,
              RansomPath = FolderPath, RansomProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              RansomCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
Services
| join kind=inner Ransom on Computer
| where RansomTime between (ServiceTime .. ServiceTime + 30m)
| project ServiceTime, RansomTime,
          DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', RansomTime, ServiceTime),
          Computer, SvcName, SvcFile, ServiceUser,
          RansomFile, RansomPath, RansomProcess, RansomCmd
| summarize arg_min(ServiceTime, *) by Computer
| order by ServiceTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.security @EventID:(7045 OR 4697) (@ServiceName:(PSEXESVC* OR psexesvc* OR PAExec* OR paexec* OR remcom* OR csrss*) OR @ServiceFileName:(*\\ADMIN$\\* OR *\\admin$\\* OR *\\Windows\\* OR *\\windows\\*)) -@ServiceFileName:(*\\System32\\svchost.exe* OR *\\system32\\svchost.exe*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
(#event_simpleName=ServiceStarted OR #event_simpleName=AsepValueUpdate)
| (ServiceDisplayName=/(?i)(PSEXESVC|PAExec|remcom|csrss)/ OR ImagePath=/(?i)\\ADMIN\$\\/ OR ImagePath=/(?i)^[A-Z]:\\Windows\\[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,12}\.exe$/)
| join({
    #event_simpleName=FileWritten
    | TargetFileName=/(?i)\.(8base|phobos|eight|eking|devos)$|\\info\.(hta|txt)$/
    | groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function=[min(@timestamp, as=RansomFirst)])
  }, field=aid, include=[RansomFirst])
| Delay := RansomFirst - @timestamp
| Delay >= 0
| Delay <= 1800000
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ServiceDisplayName, ImagePath], function=[min(@timestamp, as=ServiceTime), min(RansomFirst, as=RansomTime)])
ucs.rationale: 8Base is a Phobos-family RaaS affiliate; CISA #StopRansomware AA24-060A and multiple IR reports (VMware/Carbon Black, Acronis, Trustwave) document the operator workflow as PsExec → SYSTEM service → simultaneous Phobos detonation across the fleet, with extensions including .8base, .phobos, .eight, .eking, .devos and the canonical info.hta/info.txt ransom-note pair. ucs.title: [LLM] 8Base affiliate LSASS credential dumping via comsvcs.dll MiniDump prior to lateral movement
ucs.description: Hunts the LOLBin credential-harvesting step 8Base/Phobos operators run before fanning out via SMB admin shares: rundll32.exe invoking comsvcs.dll's MiniDump export against the lsass.exe PID, dumping process memory to a file under %TEMP%, %PROGRAMDATA%, or %APPDATA%. This rundll32→comsvcs combination is the operator's preferred T1003.001 method (LOLBAS, signed by Microsoft, AV-quiet) and immediately precedes the T1021.002 lateral movement covered in UC1.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as process values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_process from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="rundll32.exe" AND Processes.process="*comsvcs.dll*" AND (Processes.process="*MiniDump*" OR Processes.process="*#24*" OR Processes.process="*,24*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where FileName =~ "rundll32.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has "comsvcs.dll"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MiniDump","minidump","#24",",24 ")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| extend DumpPath = extract(@"(?i)comsvcs\.dll[,\s]+(?:MiniDump|#?24)\s+\d+\s+([^\s\"]+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, AccountDomain,
          ProcessCommandLine, DumpPath,
          ParentProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ProcessIntegrityLevel, ProcessTokenElevation
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\rundll32.exe"
| where CommandLine has "comsvcs.dll"
| where CommandLine has_any ("MiniDump","minidump","#24",",24 ")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE")
| extend DumpPath = extract(@"(?i)comsvcs\.dll[,\s]+(?:MiniDump|#?24)\s+\d+\s+([^\s\"]+)", 1, CommandLine)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, SubjectDomainName,
          CommandLine, DumpPath, ParentProcessName, TokenElevationType, NewProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: LSASS Memory Dump via comsvcs.dll MiniDump Export (8Base/Phobos Tradecraft)
id: 0b8de2c3-7e6a-4f1b-9ad2-8base-comsvcs
status: experimental
description: Detects rundll32.exe invoking the MiniDump export of comsvcs.dll, a LOLBAS technique used by 8Base affiliates to dump lsass.exe memory prior to lateral movement.
references:
  - https://lolbas-project.github.io/lolbas/Libraries/Comsvcs/
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-060a
author: SOC Detection Eng
date: 2026/06/04
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains: 'comsvcs.dll'
  selection_export:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'MiniDump'
      - 'minidump'
      - '#24'
      - ',24 '
  filter_system:
    User|endswith:
      - 'SYSTEM'
      - 'LOCAL SERVICE'
      - 'NETWORK SERVICE'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cmd and selection_export and not filter_system
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate dump-collection scripts used by IT for crash analysis (rare)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.001
  - attack.g8base
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) @EventID:(1 OR 4688) @Image:(*\\rundll32.exe OR *\\Rundll32.exe OR *\\RUNDLL32.EXE) @CommandLine:(*comsvcs.dll* OR *COMSVCS.DLL* OR *Comsvcs.dll*) @CommandLine:(*MiniDump* OR *minidump* OR *MINIDUMP* OR *"#24"* OR *",24 "*) -@User:(*SYSTEM* OR *LOCAL\ SERVICE* OR *NETWORK\ SERVICE*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/(?i)\\rundll32\.exe$/
| regex("(?i)comsvcs\.dll", field=CommandLine)
| regex("(?i)(minidump|#24|,24\s)", field=CommandLine)
| UserName!=/(?i)^(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE)$/
| DumpPath := regex("(?i)comsvcs\.dll[,\s]+(?:MiniDump|#?24)\s+\d+\s+(?<DumpPath>[^\s\"]+)", field=CommandLine, strict=false)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine, DumpPath], function=[min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=LastSeen), count()])
| sort(FirstSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Per CISA AA24-060A (#StopRansomware: Phobos Ransomware, the bulletin under which 8Base is tracked) and corroborating Trustwave/VMware/Acronis reporting, 8Base affiliates rely on living-off-the-land binaries for credential access — and `rundll32.exe C:\Windows\System32\comsvcs.dll, MiniDump <lsass-pid> <out>.dmp full` is the operator-of-choice technique because it's Microsoft-signed and AV-quiet.
